how_to_collect: Keep sap_erp for ECC or S/4HANA. Use sap_bw for a BW or BW/4HANA system.
ECC 6.0 EHPx / S/4HANA 20xx / BW 7.5 / BW/4HANA 20xx (System > Status, or SPAM)
hana, oracle, db2, mssql, maxdb or ase (System > Status > Database)
DB02 (or DBACOCKPIT) > Space > Used database size in GB
Number of SAP tables you expect to extract for analytics
RSA6 > count of active DataSources (or SE16N on ROOSOURCE with OBJVERS = A)
SE16N on TADIR: PGMID = R3TR / OBJECT = TABL / OBJ_NAME = Z* and Y* (add both counts)
SE16N on TADIR: OBJECT = DDLS / OBJ_NAME = Z* and Y* (custom CDS views)
SE16N on TADIR: OBJECT = PROG / OBJ_NAME = Z* and Y*
SUIM > Users by logon date (dialog users / type A / not locked)
SM37 > all jobs in the last 30 days (number of jobs)
ODQMON > subscriptions: number of non-SAP subscribers (Note 3255746 exposure)
LTRC on the SLT system: yes or no
Modules in scope, separated by semicolons: FI;CO;SD;MM;PP;PM;QM;PS;HCM;WM;EWM;TM
RSA1 > InfoProvider count (ADSOs + DSOs + InfoCubes + CompositeProviders)
RSRT or SE16N on RSZCOMPDIR (OBJVERS = A and DEFTP = REP)
ST03N > workload overview (BW: query navigation steps per day)
